settings.title: Android Auto DPI (60-480; the car's own is 240)
settings.description: Lower: smaller text, icons and buttons, more map. Applies at the next Android Auto connection (reconnect the phone).

settings.title: Tap and scroll limit while driving (stock)
settings.description: Off: the car doesn't offer the phone its speed sensor, so Android Auto doesn't lock taps and scrolling after a while on the move (like aa-proxy-rs's remove_tap_restriction). Driving status still reaches the phone, so its other driving restrictions stay.

settings.title: Video frames in flight (1-16; the car's own is 4)
settings.description: How many video frames the phone may send before the car acknowledges them. The car's 4 held wireless Android Auto to about 42 fps; 6 gave a steady 60 (smoother). Lower if taps feel slow. Applies at the next Android Auto connection.
